title: Leonida Legend — GTA VI Trophy Guide
verified: List checked 2026-11-20 against Exophase (https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/) and cross-checked with EGamers, PowerPyx, GTABase, Insider Gaming and Radio Times — all agree on all 55 names, descriptions and grades: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 secret, 0 online.
note: Trophy titles and blurbs are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every how-to below is written in our own words for this entry; each one names the published guide its facts come from. Sources are linked, never copied.

trophies.title: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.howto: Nothing to chase separately: this one fires the instant the other 54 are in the bag. Work the four phases in order — story, the 100% list, strangers and cleanup — and the platinum lands by itself. PowerPyx prices the full run near 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty; all of it offline, one playthrough, no difficulty choices.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Just Like Paradise
trophies.howto: Unmissable story trophy. Play Gone Fishing, the Chapter 1 opener, to its end and it unlocks on the spot.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: Paradise Lost
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Wrap up Chapter 1 and it pops as Chapter 2's first mission starts — just keep playing the story.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Finish Chapter 2; the trophy lands when Chapter 3 begins with Welcome to Vice City.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Clear Chapter 3; it unlocks after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Clear Chapter 4; it pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Beat the game's final mission in Chapter 5. Missions can't be replayed, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — PowerPyx suggests saving at each chapter's start and end, using the 15 manual slots.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: Trust
trophies.howto: Unmissable story trophy. Play through the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run; it unlocks mid-mission.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: Break the Bank
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Finish the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: Family Matters
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Finish the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: DWNFALL
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Finish the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: Hi-Jacked
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Finish the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: Snow Storm
trophies.howto: Unmissable. Finish the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

refs.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.title: A Long Road
trophies.howto: The toughest one in the set, according to PowerPyx and GTABase. Once the story is done, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and grind the list. It's gentler than a true 100%: roughly 60% of everything counts. Most side quests don't matter, collectibles only partly, and any 70 of the 80 challenges will do. The all-or-nothing items are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks. Story progress already counts, and nothing on the list can be missed. Do any 100 optional missions as they turn up (there are 200–300+), scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with WAiNK, and study 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars.

refs.label: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.title: Cunning Stunts
trophies.howto: Land any 250 of Leonida's 397 stunts (the 100% list wants 300). Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like. Under-bridge flights are the fastest, per PowerPyx. Watch the count under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Master of None
trophies.blurb: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.howto: Sample all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and pulling off a stunt. Progress > Activities shows which ones you've done. Most are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons, so this usually finishes itself while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.title: The Shootist
trophies.blurb: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.howto: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across the 12 range locations. The medals aren't brutal, per PowerPyx, and golds feed the 100% list too, which demands all of them. Clear the ranges one at a time after the story.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Top Fun
trophies.blurb: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.howto: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 venues (42 races total). Only a first place at every location matters, not every single race. Drone races also feed the 100% list, which wants all of them.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.howto: Win 20 distinct races — the same event twice doesn't count. The 100% list asks for 30, so keep racing past 20. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race spots around Leonida; work through them and the trophy fires on the twentieth different win.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Baited My Tackle
trophies.blurb: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.howto: Out-fish Cal. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces him, Cal texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map marker). Head there and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.title: Stick Fiddler
trophies.howto: Finish an arcade game — play any one of the four in-game titles to its final level: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three run on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines around the world. Reaching the end once is enough; you don't need every challenge.

trophies.title: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.blurb: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.howto: Finish Andy's last mission. Her line is Lucia-only and starts by itself in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her Belville address. Clear her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy fires on the final one. The quests stay open after the story.

trophies.title: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.blurb: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.howto: Finish Kenton's last mission. His line starts by itself in Chapter 1; after Island Dreams he calls and shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — sweep the ocean floor with the metal detector, find the chests and bring them back. He goes quiet for a while mid-story, then comes back (playing as Jason, calling Brian in Chapter 2 hurries it along). Follow it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.title: The Lone Rider
trophies.blurb: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.howto: Finish Billy's last mission. His line starts by itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Clear his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy fires on the last. Everything stays open after the story.

trophies.title: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.blurb: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.howto: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some questlines qualify — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie don't count. The strands stay open in free-roam after the story, and the in-game trophy list tracks your count. PowerPyx notes more qualifying strangers are still being found, so check their Strangers & Freaks page if you stall at 7.

trophies.title: Supply & Demand
trophies.blurb: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.howto: Finish Randy's last mission. His Wish List starts by itself after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him with the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); scan cars with WAiNK to match them against the list, and deliver them in good shape for better pay. The cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and the list stays open after the story.

trophies.title: Spin On This!
trophies.blurb: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.howto: Finish Tyrone's last mission. His line is Jason-only and starts by itself after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — wreck the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, and Tyrone then hands you Spin On This, shutting the labs down. Everything stays open after the story.

trophies.title: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.blurb: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.howto: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots at 10 locations, per PowerPyx and GTABase (the 100% list only needs 15). Both Lucia and Jason can meditate at each spot, and each counts. THIS IS THE ONE TROPHY THAT CAN POSSIBLY BE MISSED: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony at Jason's house — follow her, say yes, and meditate. That balcony session is gone after Chapter 1, and nobody has confirmed yet whether it counts, so do it to be safe. The final meditation needs both characters playable, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.title: Fair Game
trophies.blurb: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.howto: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His line is Jason-only: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle and marks hunting spots on the map; bring back the animals he asks for. The 15 Target Decks feed the 100% list, so this comes along naturally — but exactly which animal fires the trophy is still unconfirmed, per PowerPyx, so work through Bret's decks and it should unlock on the way.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.howto: Finish 3 Collectible Card sets. The game holds 18 card sets, and the 100% list wants 15 — so the trophy's 3 sets arrive early if you collect as you go. PowerPyx has a full card-set location guide; cards are scattered across Leonida, so grab any you pass.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: You WAiNKer!
trophies.howto: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold up on the D-pad, then R1, to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures around Leonida — there are well over 100 (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, per PowerPyx), so any 100 will do. The 100% list also wants 100, so the trophy and the list line up exactly.

trophies.title: One Last Thing
trophies.howto: Finish 50 Challenges. There are 80 in total and you only need 50 for the trophy (70 for the 100% list), so skip the hardest ones. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most finish on their own while you work the other trophies — save this for late cleanup, then pick the easiest ones left.

trophies.title: Hot Together
trophies.blurb: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.howto: Shake a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and get clear of the heat. Both characters together are needed — available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; summon your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Build 4 stars, then leave the red heat zone (not just the flashing search area). PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. You'll probably earn this on its own during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always bring 4 stars.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Retail Therapy
trophies.blurb: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.howto: Hit 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while the Wanted Level stays alive. After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), keep the flashing wanted level going while you strike three robbery targets in a row — bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing, and bring your partner. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); rob a couple of items in each, crack the back-room safe, and if the trophy doesn't fire after the third, hit a fourth. The pop lags about half a minute after you leave the third shop.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Whip It Good
trophies.howto: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold up on the D-pad) and scan vehicles — just stand by a busy road and scan the traffic; you don't need to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% list wants 200 base models scanned, so this fires on the way. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Gunslinger
trophies.blurb: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.howto: Drop 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus. Trigger it with L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Top focus up first with food, drink or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up five gang members at a gang operation and drop them without missing — soldiers, police and civilians don't seem to count. Focus has 4 levels (raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots), so this gets easier late in the game.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.blurb: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.howto: Leave VCIA in a plane nobody scheduled. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — it has to be one hooked to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. Easiest at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km clear of the airport and the trophy fires (slightly delayed).

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Challenging Tank
trophies.howto: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — steal a military tank. Tanks sit in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy fires.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Sneakthief
trophies.blurb: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.howto: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — that unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Slip in through the back door with the Snap Gun (never kick it), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and kill the alarm, then walk out clean. The trophy fires shortly after you leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot, per PowerPyx.

trophies.title: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.howto: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and get away. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (it starts by itself): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — one of you carries a bag each. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip to mark more security vans (after his earlier Payday Loans jobs). Every vault robbery brings 4 stars instantly, so escape on a fast bike and swap vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% list wants all 8, so the trophy comes by itself; a single vault can pay up to $205,000.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.blurb: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.howto: Rob an Armored Truck and get away. It fires by itself in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck that delivered the cash. You can also get it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it open and escape the red heat radius (sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs). All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.title: The Goodtime State
trophies.howto: See all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest route is by plane: fly over every black fog patch until the map is clear. PowerPyx has a dedicated unfogging guide with the best plane to use.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Pest Control
trophies.blurb: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.howto: Rob an Illegal Operation from every gang. There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations; only one per gang is needed for the trophy, but the 100% list wants all 39, so it comes by itself. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked by the story. Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: In The Beginning…
trophies.blurb: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.howto: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar. PowerPyx documents this method with photos; EGamers still listed the steps as unconfirmed at their last check on 18 November, so if it doesn't fire on the first try, order again at the bar.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Capital Offense
trophies.blurb: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.howto: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to GTA III's Banshee. You need the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City, and you can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward straight through the showroom window, and keep driving — the pop lags a little. Only that blue Banshee counts.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.blurb: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.howto: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation you first visit in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation to blow the safe. The valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy fires after you escape the police, and you don't need all three in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so you can return for anything you missed.

trophies.title: Personal Best
trophies.howto: A partnership with mass appeal — reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Buy a gym membership and work out with both characters together (summon your partner with right on the D-pad + Triangle — while one trains, the other progresses too). Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > character > Strength. Gyms are marked on the map under Activities; you can also work out at home after the story.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.howto: Choices made (for better or worse) — rack up 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile. Switch on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon: stealthy objectives, clean escapes and destroying evidence push you Professional; wounding enemies is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing is Psycho; and Irredeemable is permanent — steer clear of it, since cops then shoot on sight. It builds up on its own through every robbery and fight, so it usually fires by itself; if it's the last one left, farm it, but don't push into Irredeemable.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.howto: Second time's the charm. In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store; come back later as Lucia alone and rob the same store again, then escape on foot. It opens up after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, aim at the teller, deal with security, empty the three cash drawers, then run — on foot, not in a car — until you're clear of the search area. The pop is delayed.

trophies.title: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.howto: What the hell just happened? — finish the UFO easter egg. After 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it isn't there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you'll see the UFO's bright blue light — walk toward it, and it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer help, and walk back to her car at the roadside to fire the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

trophies.title: Ten Pin
trophies.blurb: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.howto: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square inside 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach work best. EGamers still listed the exact method as unconfirmed at their last check, while PowerPyx documents the bike-kick method above — so treat the count (10 kicks, 60 seconds) as the method to try.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.blurb: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.howto: Bank $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check first — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, per PowerPyx). The $250,000 adds up across robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults are the big earner — up to $205,000 per vault — once they open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. It comes naturally while doing the robberies for 100%.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: Treat Yo Self
trophies.howto: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos cost the most, so they're the fastest way to burn through the total — Ammu-Nation, mod shops, tattoo studios, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, and electronics stores all count. The total adds up across the whole game, so this usually fires by itself while you gear up.

trophies.title: Little Boxes
trophies.howto: Buy every garage property. There are 8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story ones that don't count), costing about $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them all through the app. Robberies are the quickest money-maker, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

refs.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.title: On the Spot
trophies.blurb: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.howto: Get 10 vehicles onto the Scooter Bros app. It shows up on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, and it lets stolen cars be registered so they can be delivered to you anywhere. Garages come first (see Little Boxes) — every garage adds parking spots. Then take stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and pick Respray, then Register. Early on he only accepts cars with no tracker; from Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray instead. Each registration costs cash, so stick to cheap low-end cars and bikes.

phases.name: Story first
phases.blurb: Run the story, Chapters 1–5, start to finish. Straight after the mission Down to Earth, do Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation — the single trophy that might be missable. While you play, scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals through binoculars; both count toward the 100% list later. Save by hand at the start of every chapter, since missions can't be replayed.

phases.name: The 100% checklist
phases.blurb: Once the story is over, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The list is forgiving — roughly 60% of everything — but it insists on all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks, plus any 70 of the 80 challenges. Most of this phase's trophies fire while you work the list.

phases.name: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
phases.blurb: Clear the stranger strands (8 count toward the silver) and the character questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, then mop up the secret and stunt trophies. Every quest giver tied to a trophy is still around in free-roam after the story.

phases.name: Platinum
phases.eta: the moment the rest are done
phases.blurb: Earn the other 54 trophies and Vice Got a Price! fires. Whole run: about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx). No online trophies, no DLC trophies, one playthrough — and keep cheats off for the whole run: any cheat kills trophies and saving.
